name: EHDSMedication
title: Medication model
description: Logical model for prescribed/dispensed medication. The model is shared by statements, requests, dispensations, and treatment lines. Each of those may have different restrictions in FHIR profile. Model is suitable for generic/virtual medications as well as branded/real products.

element.short: Medication model
element.definition: Logical model for prescribed/dispensed medication. The model is shared by statements, requests, dispensations, and treatment lines. Each of those may have different restrictions in FHIR profile. Model is suitable for generic/virtual medications as well as branded/real products.

element.short: Identifier or code for the product (virtual product, branded product or package). If several identifiers are specified, they shall not have conflicting meanings or very different granularities.
element.definition: Identifier or code for the product (virtual product, branded product or package). If several identifiers are specified, they shall not have conflicting meanings or very different granularities.

element.short: Classification (e.g. ATC; narcotic/psychotropic; orphan drug; etc.)
element.definition: Classification (e.g. ATC; narcotic/psychotropic; orphan drug; etc.)

element.short: Name of the product (full name, invented name, other). When the product has different names, the appropriate one for the context should be used. Translations of names can be provided.
element.definition: Name of the product (full name, invented name, other). When the product has different names, the appropriate one for the context should be used. Translations of names can be provided.

element.short: Dose form(s) on a product level. Dose form for a single package item is defined below.

element.short: Overall amount of product in one package (100ml; 20 tablets; 1 creme & 6 pessaries)
